summary: Game crashes/freezes after creating/entering a Superflat world without presets
description: When create a superflat world without presets, it crashes. 1.16.2-pre2 Description: Ticking player java.lang.IllegalStateException: Unregistered biome at bw.b(SourceFile:88) at java.base/java.util.Optional.orElseThrow(Optional.java:385) at bw.a(SourceFile:88) at bw.a(SourceFile:68) at bx$a.a(SourceFile:55) at bx.a(SourceFile:31) at ck.a(SourceFile:62) at bx.a(SourceFile:31) at aah.v_(SourceFile:484) at aay.b(SourceFile:207) at nd.a(SourceFile:234) at aax.c(SourceFile:173) at net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer.b(SourceFile:881) at net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer.a(SourceFile:810) at emy.a(SourceFile:92) at net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer.w(SourceFile:669) at net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer.a(SourceFile:254) at java.base/java.lang.Thread.run(Thread.java:844) 1.16.2-pre3 [18:07:58] [Render thread/WARN]: Received invalid biome id: -1
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft Java Edition 1.16.2-pre2.
2. Navigate to "Create New World".
3. Select "Superflat" as the world type.
4. Ensure no presets are selected and leave all other settings at their defaults.
5. Click "Create World" to generate the Superflat world.
6. Attempt to enter the newly created Superflat world.
7. Observe that the game crashes or freezes upon entering the world.
8. Take a screenshot of the crash or freeze state if possible.
9. Exit the game and gather the `debug` folder contents, including `latest.log` and any relevant `.txt` files from `crash-reports`.
10. Attach the screenshots and debug ZIP to the report for further analysis.
Environment: Minecraft Java Edition Versions: 1.16.2 Pre-release 2, 1.16.2 Pre-release 3
Observed Behavior: When attempting to create or enter a Superflat world without presets in Minecraft version 1.16.2-pre2, the game crashes immediately upon entering the world. The crash is accompanied by the error message "java.lang.IllegalStateException: Unregistered biome" with a stack trace indicating issues within the biome registration process. In version 1.16.2-pre3, instead of crashing, the game logs a warning stating "Received invalid biome id: -1." This issue specifically arises when attempting to generate and enter a Superflat world without using any predefined presets, leading to an unregistered or invalid biome being encountered during world generation, which in turn causes the crash or error.
Expected Behavior: When creating or entering a Superflat world without presets, the game should load the world normally without crashing or freezing. The player should be able to explore the flat terrain and interact with the environment as expected, without encountering any biome-related errors or issues.
